note: Pairing secret travels in URL fragment only, never query. Devices relay-local, hashed at rest, revocable, audited, never synced/exported. Extends docs/PAIRING.md.

envIdentity.envId: stable uuid, atomic init, survives restarts + endpoint changes
envIdentity.advertisedRoutes: reachability hints only; client proves what works

pairUrlRules: secret in FRAGMENT only — never in query (fragments stay out of hosted-origin requests)
one-time link per device; fresh link per new device
treat pairing URLs + abd- creds as passwords (no screenshots/logs/bug reports)

endpoints.issue: POST /api/pair/issue (admin, token-checked; body {label?, ttl?, scopes?}) -> {pairUrl, expiresAt}
endpoints.exchange: POST /api/pair/exchange (body {pairToken, label?, scopes?}) -> {deviceId, credential (abd-..., once only)}; requested scopes must be subset of granted (narrow-only, never widen)
endpoints.revoke: POST /api/pair/revoke (admin; body {deviceId}) -> immediate 403 on next use

defaultScope: full device (today's secret-equivalent) unless narrowed at exchange
routeWalk: ordered routes, first-that-works; preflight earlier routes while on later one + cooldown; learned LAN/tailnet reuse learning credential; never silently fall back to loopback
